elements.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
elements.evidence: Rendered language omits § 7.2’s disclose-and-match obligation and expressly states that Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment.

elements.element: The Customer MFN covers only a defined product.
elements.evidence: No Customer MFN exists in the rendered language, so there is no operative MFN defining a covered product.

elements.element: The Customer MFN lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: No Customer MFN or 12-month duration appears in the rendered language.

elements.element: The Customer MFN contains reasonable like-for-like comparison carve-outs.
elements.evidence: No Customer MFN or comparison carve-outs appear in the rendered language.
